issues.desc: CHK-001/CHK-002 do not make the core pre-REVIEW, non-blocking readiness boundary mechanically verifiable. The happy-path verification only requires a generic pre-DONE hint, and the checklist excludes do not explicitly prohibit adding a new hard REVIEW/TEST blocker for behind-main state. An implementation could therefore satisfy the current checklist with a TEST/DONE-only warning or a new blocking gate while missing baseline item 4 target of early read-only main-sync readiness before substantial review/test work accumulates.
